svg.title: Vigil SCC sequence diagram, happy path
svg.desc: Sequence diagram showing an AI agent enqueueing a command batch through the MCP server to the queue manager, a human operator approving via the operator console, execution via the SSH registry against a remote host, and the AI agent polling for completion.
svg.text: human can interject: approve, reject, or edit
queue mgr = queue manager · operator ui = operator console
ssh reg = ssh registry · remote host = remote server
